_about: Hand corrections to OSM road geometry, each checked against the 2025 aerial; see pipeline/osm_corrections.py.

235322066.note: Harrison Avenue's north end on West 6th Street, moved 4.3 m west along West 6th to where the gravel road's centre (traced on the 2025 aerial, straight to 0.74 m) meets it. OSM drew Harrison 3.5-4.5 m east of the gravel, along the boat yard and the green-roofed building (review 2026-10-19, #6).

235322070.note: Harrison Avenue's south end on West 7th Street, moved 3.3 m west along West 7th to the traced gravel centreline (review 2026-10-19, #6).

21838771.note: Shady Lane's bend from the junction at (489,-2332) west to (463,-2350): OSM cut straight across the inside of the curve, through the yards and over house 800002396. The points follow the paved curve's centre traced on the 2025 aerial (review 2026-10-19, #5).
